description: Identifies and remediates stale Active Directory computer accounts using a staged lifecycle: disable accounts inactive beyond the threshold, then delete accounts that have been disabled for the retention period. Dry-run mode reports candidates without making changes.

inactive_days_threshold.label: Inactive Days Threshold
inactive_days_threshold.description: Accounts with no logon for this many days are candidates for disabling (default: 90)

disabled_retention_days.label: Disabled Retention Days
disabled_retention_days.description: Accounts disabled for this many days are candidates for deletion (default: 30)

target_ou.label: Target OU DN
target_ou.description: Scope cleanup to a specific OU (default: entire domain)

disable_only.label: Disable Only
disable_only.description: Only disable stale accounts — do not delete any accounts (default: false)

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Report stale account candidates only — no accounts disabled or deleted

rollback.description: Re-enable all disabled accounts from this run. Deleted accounts cannot be restored via rollback — use AD Recycle Bin or backup restore for deleted accounts if recycle bin was enabled.

steps.description: Query AD for stale computer accounts based on lastLogonTimestamp and pwdLastSet
Disable computer accounts inactive beyond threshold
Delete accounts that have been disabled beyond the retention period
